authorship.author: OpenAI GPT-6 / Codex
authorship.limitation: RISK-005: the initial benchmark author, implementation team, and semantic reviewer share model context; scores are portfolio evidence, not independent validation.

interpretation.invalidInputExpectation: HTTP 422 VALIDATION_ERROR with a rawNotes field error; neither formatter is invoked. Invalid cases are scored as input rejection, excluded from successful-response schema and placement denominators, and never hidden from the report.
interpretation.emptyAllowedSections: An explicit absence assertion. Negated-blocker-only input should produce empty sections. It must not be counted as omitted work or converted to an active blocker. Score the source assertion from the empty Blockers state.
interpretation.ambiguousPlacement: Cases with uncertain=true or multiple allowedSections are excluded from unambiguous placement F1, while remaining eligible for factuality, exact preservation, warnings, and coverage checks.
interpretation.sourceFacts: Facts are annotated supporting spans, not a promise that runtime segmentation produces identical spans. Match semantic support and exact protected strings across the complete returned draft.
interpretation.forbiddenClaims: These are unsupported propositions to detect semantically, not a blacklist that prohibits quoting the same text as source data.
interpretation.providerPathTags: Exercise each tagged failure with a deterministic provider stub. Provider-protected-omission removes a protected span when present and otherwise returns empty arrays to exercise omission validation. These are integration checks, not measured live model quality.
interpretation.maximalItems: Owner-authorized correction: an item may contain up to 10,000 Unicode code points; normalized input remains limited to 10,000 and total draft text to 20,000.
interpretation.pairwiseBlinding: Assign deterministic randomized A/B display labels before review, retain the engine key separately, and reveal identities after scoring. No live-provider usefulness claim is possible from stub output.
interpretation.semanticReview: Record reviewer type, model/version or human role, case-level supported/unsupported/omitted facts, and rationale. Exact-match automation is not a substitute for semantic reviewer scores.
interpretation.doubleReview: When two reviewers are available, double-score at least twenty cases and record agreement and adjudication. Otherwise report a single reviewer and no agreement claim.

criteria.numerator: represented required source facts, including correctly rendered absence assertions
required protected token occurrences preserved exactly

criteria.measure: macro precision, recall and F1 over Yesterday, Today and Blockers on unambiguous required facts
false active blocker count and preserved resolution/negation count
required warnings present; no unsupported warning; existing item and/or source fragment target
successful outputs satisfying the canonical response model / valid cases executed

meaningful fragments mapped to output or targeted omission warning / meaningful source fragments; fallback preserves all source content apart from explicitly represented absence assertions and headings
structured preferred / non-tied blinded pairs; report tie count and denominator separately
item edits, deletes, additions and section moves required in review simulation; report each separately

claimRules.missingProviderCredentials: Run fallback and deterministic provider integration stubs; record live primary quality, latency, cost and usefulness as not_run or not_measured.
claimRules.usefulnessFailure: Keep the provider integration available but do not claim demonstrated improvement over fallback.
claimRules.thresholdChanges: Do not lower gates or edit the frozen benchmark after observing formatter output. A dataset correction requires a new version and hash and invalidates previous comparisons.
claimRules.unrunChecks: A missing result is not a passing result. Preserve failures and not_run findings at case and metric level.
